description: cadence-orchestrator tpm guard (Claude Code plugin): armed per session when the user types the tpm skill, then keeps the main thread from doing core work.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/adapters/claude/shim.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; echo 'tpm guard: python3 or the shim is missing; allowing' >&2; exit 0

f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/adapters/claude/shim.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; echo 'tpm guard: python3 or the shim is missing; allowing' >&2; exit 0
